html:
Quang Phu Cau Incense Village is a newly emerging virtual living spot in Hanoi, not only attracting domestic tourists but also attracting international tourists to visit, enjoy and take pictures in the incense village.

Although located about 35 km from the center of Hanoi, this place brings a unique beauty of a peaceful countryside, with a traditional craft village that no one knows when it started.

Quang Phu Cau Incense Village not only brings income to the local people but is also a unique new tourist destination, many tourists come here to hunt for pictures and save beautiful pictures for themselves.

If you plan to travel to Hanoi, visit Quang Phu Cau Incense Village, if you are a lover of traditional beauty, visiting the countryside scenery, Quang Phu Cau Incense Village is the destination for you.

From the center of Hanoi city, visitors can take a bus to visit the incense village, or you can ride a motorbike to enjoy the scenery, the peaceful scenery of the Vietnamese incense village.

The incense stick craft village of Quang Phu Cau, no one knows when it was created, but until now the incense stick craft village is still one of the traditional craft villages associated with many generations of Vietnamese people, by skilled craftsmen.

Currently, Quang Phu Cau incense village has become the most famous incense stick craft village in the suburbs of the capital. When visiting the incense village, you will encounter the beauty of a rural area with both ancient and modern features.

What to eat when traveling to Quang Phu Cau incense village?

This place is not only known for its traditional craft village, or learning about the culture of Vietnamese villages, but when coming here, visitors can also enjoy delicious and attractive dishes. Let’s take a look at the delicious and attractive dishes at Quang Phu Cau incense village.

Although it is about 40km from Hanoi, Quang Phu Cau is a place with many famous delicious dishes, with unique ways of processing that will bring visitors the quintessence of unique culinary culture.

Especially when coming to Quang Phu Cau, visitors can enjoy the unique porridge dish, talking about porridge is certainly no longer strange to anyone, however, in Quang Phu Cau, porridge is processed to bring a very unique flavor.

In addition, you should enjoy delicious dishes such as: Noi Xa sticky rice cake, Thanh Am rice paper, Hoa Phu sticky rice cake, Quang Nguyen floating cake, Hoang Xa flower porridge…

The delicious dish that makes diners remember forever is the go porridge, the main ingredients are fresh perch, sticky rice and added dried onions and spices… when enjoyed, it will bring a unique delicious flavor that diners will remember forever.

Go porridge served with banh khuc is a popular dish in the northern region, and is sold all year round, but is most popular in winter, when the weather is cold, enjoying a hot bowl of go porridge is nothing more interesting.
